title: Qiagen QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit Processing Protocol
author: Arnouv Nayana
materials: Return the QIAquick column to the collection tube.

steps.title: Excise and Weigh Gel Slice
steps.instruction: Excise the DNA fragment from the agarose gel using a clean, sharp scalpel and weigh the slice in a colorless tube.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the maximum amount of gel per column does not exceed 400 mg (approximately 0.4 cm³).

steps.title: Dissolve Gel Slice
steps.instruction: Add Buffer QG to the gel slice and incubate to dissolve.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 volumes of Buffer QG to 1 volume of gel (e.g., 100 mg gel ~ 100 µL).
For agarose gels >2%, add 6 volumes of Buffer QG.
Incubate at 50 °C for 10 minutes, or until the gel slice has completely dissolved.
Vortex every 2–3 minutes to assist dissolution.

steps.title: Adjust Mixture pH and Yield
steps.instruction: Verify the mixture color and optimize yield based on fragment size.

substeps.instruction: Check that the mixture is yellow; if the color is orange or violet, add 10 µL of 3M sodium acetate (pH 5.0) and mix.
For fragments ≤500 bp or ≥4 kb, add 1 gel volume of isopropanol to the sample and mix to increase yield.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Column
steps.instruction: Load the sample onto a QIAquick spin column and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Place a QIAquick spin column in a provided 2 mL collection tube.
Apply the sample to the column.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 17,900 × g (13,000 rpm) at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through.
If the sample volume exceeds the maximum load of 800 µL, load and spin again.

steps.title: Optional Column Wash for Specific Applications
steps.instruction: Perform an additional wash if the DNA is intended for sequencing, in vitro transcription, or microinjection.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer QG to the column.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 17,900 × g (13,000 rpm) at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash DNA Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column with Buffer PE to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 750 µL Buffer PE to the QIAquick column.
For salt-sensitive applications (e.g., sequencing, blunt-ended ligation), let the column stand for 2–5 minutes.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 17,900 × g (13,000 rpm) at room temperature and discard flow-through.
Return the column to the same collection tube and centrifuge for an additional 1 minute at 17,900 × g (13,000 rpm) at room temperature to remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Elute Purified DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the column into a clean microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the QIAquick column in a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 50 µL Buffer EB (10 mM Tris·Cl, pH 8.5) to the center of the membrane (use 30 µL for higher DNA concentration).
Let the column stand for 1 minute.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 17,900 × g (13,000 rpm) at room temperature to elute the DNA.
Note: Average eluate volume is 48 µL (from 50 µL input) or 28 µL (from 30 µL input).

steps.title: Prepare DNA for Gel Analysis
steps.instruction: Prepare the purified DNA for gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of Loading Dye to 5 volumes of purified DNA.
Mix by pipetting before loading.
